spans.s:
1 ह्री जिह्रेति pp. ह्रीत (& ह्रीण) be ashamed or
abashed. C. ह्रेपयति put to shame, confound. I. जेह्रीयते be
greatly ashamed.

ह्रीतमुख^1 a. shame-faced.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: alph. order. cf. MW.
